extracted.intended_audience: researchers, research organisations, businesses, and members of the public interested in UK research and innovation funding and support
extracted.subtask_description: A high-level overview of UK Research and Innovation's priorities, areas of activity, and the kinds of investment and support it provides to researchers, businesses, institutions and the public. The page summarizes program areas, engagement channels, infrastructure and culture goals rather than giving detailed application criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide investment and support for researchers and businesses
rubrics_metrics.description: We provide investment and support for researchers and businesses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General mission statement framing UKRI's role in building a world-class research system through funding and support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Help researchers develop new skills and further their careers
rubrics_metrics.description: We help our researchers develop new skills, enabling them to further their careers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasises skills development and career progression as an objective of UKRI support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enable collaboration and engagement across and beyond research communities
rubrics_metrics.description: We enable collaboration and engagement across and beyond our communities, involving the wider public.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on fostering collaborative work internally within research communities and with the wider public.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improve capabilities across the UK research system (national and international)
rubrics_metrics.description: We improve the capabilities across the research system, within the UK and internationally.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: UKRI aims to strengthen capacity and capabilities both domestically and through international activity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop world-class infrastructure
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing world-class infrastructure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Investment in facilities, equipment and capability to support research excellence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support an inclusive and ethical research culture
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting an inclusive and ethical research culture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commitment to research integrity and promoting equality, diversity and inclusion across the research ecosystem.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investing in research and innovation (areas of investment and support)
rubrics_metrics.description: Discover the wide range of research and innovation areas, programmes, themes and funds that we invest in and support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Invitation to browse UKRI's portfolio of funding routes and thematic investments; implies breadth of funding mechanisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investing in people and businesses
rubrics_metrics.description: Investing in people and businesses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: High-level category indicating targeted support for both individuals (researchers) and business partners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Developing people and skills (support at every career stage)
rubrics_metrics.description: Read about the ways we’re supporting research professionals to grow at every stage of their career, including through Future Leaders Fellowships.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mentions specific schemes (Future Leaders Fellowships) and an emphasis on career-stage coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research commercialisation (translate research to market)
rubrics_metrics.description: Find out how we help researchers, businesses and investors transform research into market-ready products and services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on supporting translation, commercialisation and partnerships between research and industry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency on past funding (help make applications more competitive)
rubrics_metrics.description: Help make your application more competitive with information about funding decisions and awarded grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: UKRI provides information on previous funding decisions and awarded grants to help applicants improve competitiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engaging and collaborating (how we engage with community and how you can get involved)
rubrics_metrics.description: The ways we engage with our community and beyond, and how you can get involved.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers engagement channels and invitations to stakeholders to participate in UKRI activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaboration (support for teaming up nationally and internationally)
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn how we’re supporting UK researchers to team up with the best minds and facilities in the UK and around the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasises facilitation of partnerships across institutions and borders to access expertise and facilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public engagement (resources on public participation in research)
rubrics_metrics.description: Browse information and resources on public participation and engagement in research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources and guidance aimed at increasing public involvement and communication of research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Teaching resources (materials for schools and students)
rubrics_metrics.description: Resources and activities for schools and students.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Educational outreach materials to connect research with school-aged audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investing across the UK (support for places and regions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn how we support places and regions throughout England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regional distribution of funding and place-based investment to strengthen local research ecosystems.

rubrics_metrics.name: International funding and support (support for collaborative research across the world)
rubrics_metrics.description: How we fund and support collaborative research across the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mechanisms and programmes to facilitate international collaboration and funding partnerships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Infrastructure investments (facilities, equipment and capability)
rubrics_metrics.description: Get an overview of our investments in world-class research facilities, equipment and capability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers large-scale capital investment priorities and support for research platforms and tools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research culture (integrity, equality, diversity and inclusion)
rubrics_metrics.description: Understand how we’re supporting research integrity and promoting equality, diversity and inclusion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Activities and policies aimed at improving the norms, ethics and inclusiveness of the research environment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research financial sustainability (understand and support sector finances)
rubrics_metrics.description: How UKRI is working to understand and support the financial sustainability of the sector.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work to assess and support the long-term financial health of research organisations and the sector.
